validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/SPEC: confirmed real, not a GEM-only entity. The sheet's own cited source, EGPC's 'Operation Projects (Completed)' page (http://www.egpc.com.eg/CompleteOperProj.aspx), explicitly lists this exact line by name and specs: 'Construction of (4) petroleum products pipelines at SOPC/PPC ... Dekhela/ Wadi AlQamar new LPG PL 12"/7 km' -- matching GEM's Fuel=LPG, Diameter=12in, LengthKnown=7km, StartLocation=Dekhela, EndLocation=Wadi Al Qamar exactly. This is EGPC's own primary source (Egypt's state petroleum holding company), not a generic/aggregate page that merely mentions Egypt in passing -- it names this specific pipeline. A second, genuinely independent source was found via the wiki's harvested citation pool and read in full (Arabic): Al-Rai (Kuwaiti daily), 2015-07-30, 'Tacwin ihtiyati min al-butagas' -- https://www.alraimedia.com/article/594791/... -- reports (translated): 'a pipeline is currently being implemented from Dekhela port to the Wadi Al Qamar area in Alexandria, 7 km long, to receive imported LPG (butagas) and transfer it into the petroleum-products pipeline network.' This independently corroborates route (Dekhela->Wadi Al Qamar), province (Alexandria, matching StartState/Province and EndState/Province), length (7 km), and fuel (LPG). The two sources are unrelated in origin (EGPC official site vs. a Kuwaiti newspaper) and neither traces to GEM or to abarrelfull -- meets the >=2-independent bar, tier=high. TIMELINE: Al-Rai (2015) describes it as under construction; EGPC's Completed-Projects page (retrieved by our own harvest 2026-03-04) lists it as complete -- a consistent, non-contradictory trajectory that supports Status=operating (no conflict found). CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType=transmission is the roster-wide convention for GOIT products/LPG evacuation lines of this kind (same pattern on P7339, P7333, P7364, etc.) -- not flagged as wrong absent a finer GOIT vocabulary term. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 46-row Egypt-oil roster -- no other row shares this name or this Dekhela/Wadi Al Qamar route; the only other EGPC-listed LPG line from the same construction program is P7339 (Abu Rudeis-Wadi Feran, a different route in Sinai, also named in the same EGPC paragraph) -- not a duplicate of P7338. ATTRIBUTION: EGPC's own page attributes construction to subsidiaries 'SOPC/PPC' (Suez Oil Processing Co / Petroleum Pipelines Co), which could argue for a more specific Operator, but Owner1='Egyptian General Petroleum Corp' at 100% matches the convention used across every other EGPC-owned line in this same roster (P7325, P7333, P7364, etc. all use the identical owner string) -- not treated as an error.
